items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well that was for those two kids, uh, young boys, Alden and David, uh. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I believe that who that was.

ctx.x: But anyhow, it was Albert Glennon and the drummer, it was Albert Jive, he had that thing. Clarinet? Mealy's old clarinet, yeah. Trombone? Harrison Brazler. How many trumpets? Dee and, uh, and, uh, Lawrence, Lawrence and Diddy.
Well that was for those two kids, uh, young boys, Alden and David, uh.
Yeah, I believe that who that was. All of us, David.
